scope: 1.1 This standard prescribes the material, constructional, performance and other requirements of multi-crop thresher. 1.2 The standard is applicable to threshers for single crops as well as for multiple crops. NOTES 1 Generally multi-crop threshers have spike tooth type threshing cylinders which are used for threshing multiple crops, such as wheat, oilseeds, pulses, rice, etc. 2 Depending upon the farmers requirements of crops suitable adjustments may be made in the thresher to use it for multiple crops. Additional accessories (concave, sieves and pullies) are supplied to make the adjustments.
